notes.notes:
Go on a wholesome adventure and become a master ranger!

Get ready to giggle and grow.

On sale until 17th of April:

[list]
[*] Added an accessibility option to keep the mouse cursor unlocked
[/list]

notes.title: 4_41A
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Save system has been reworked, old saves (most recent 30 for manual saves and 15 for auto saves) are now kept, and can be continued from the main menu. 
[*] Old saves will be automatically converted to the new system.
[/list]

notes.title: 4_40F
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an unreachable chest.
[*] Fixed an error upon resuming particular dialogues.
[*] Fixed invisible bamboo.
[/list]

notes.title: 4_40E
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed some quest objectives not getting marked as complete.
[*] Adjusted LOD bias for low graphics to reduce object pop-in.
[/list]

notes.title: 4_40C
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Autosaves can be disabled in the settings.
[/list]

notes.title: 4_34H
notes.notes:
- Fixed Lumo not accepting pebbles.
- Removed some duplicate mushrooms.
- Map purchases should not fail anymore.

notes.title: 4_34F
notes.notes: - Fixed issues with some cinematics not progressing as intended

notes.title: Hotfix 4_34B
notes.notes:
- At the Blue Tree, the cinematic would get stuck if a particular condition was met. This has now been addressed.
- Game now saves automatically when finishing the starting area quest chain.
